Tracking events are anchored on Ethereum: Tracking events are anchored on Ethereum Sepolia
Every new tracking event hash is written: Every new tracking event hash is written to the ChainDepo contract on the Sepolia test network. The shipment page shows the transaction link for each anchored event, and you can check it on Sepolia Etherscan.
Track any shipment with its code, no acc: Track any shipment with its code, no account needed
Paste a tracking code such as CD261013A1: Paste a tracking code such as CD261013A1B2C3D4 into the form on the home page or the shipment list. The shipment page shows the route, the event timeline and the chain check.
Shipments without a carrier are listed i: Shipments without a carrier are listed in My Page for carrier accounts. A carrier claims a shipment, then adds the pickup, transit and delivery events.
Prices are shown in Korean won: Prices are shown in Korean won
All shipment prices are entered and disp: All shipment prices are entered and displayed in KRW without decimals.
What does a tracking code look like?: What does a tracking code look like?
It starts with `CD`, then the creation d: It starts with `CD`, then the creation date as YYMMDD, then 8 letters or digits, for example `CD261013A1B2C3D4`. The shipper gets it when the shipment is created.
Do I need an account to track a shipment: Do I need an account to track a shipment?
No. Anyone with the tracking code can op: No. Anyone with the tracking code can open the shipment page and see its route, timeline and chain check.
Created: the shipment is posted. Picked: Created: the shipment is posted. Picked up: the carrier has it. In transit: it is moving between cities, and there can be several in-transit events. Delivered: it reached the destination. Cancelled: an admin stopped the shipment.
No carrier has picked it up yet. The sta: No carrier has picked it up yet. The status changes when the carrier adds the pickup event.
Log in with a shipper account, open My P: Log in with a shipper account, open My Page and choose "Create shipment". Enter the title, route, type, weight and price in KRW, add photos, and save. You get the tracking code right away.
Shipments run between nine Korean cities: Shipments run between nine Korean cities. You can see them on the home page map and in the shipment filters.
Can I change a shipment after it is crea: Can I change a shipment after it is created?
While it is still Created, you can edit,: While it is still Created, you can edit, cancel or delete it in My Page → My shipments. After pickup the details are locked. Tracking events can never be edited or deleted, because each one is linked to the one before it.
In Korean won, without decimals, for exa: In Korean won, without decimals, for example ₩85,000.
How does a carrier get a shipment?: How does a carrier get a shipment?
Either the shipper assigns a carrier whe: Either the shipper assigns a carrier when creating the shipment, or a carrier claims an open shipment from My Page. Only one carrier can hold a shipment.
Only the carrier assigned to the shipmen: Only the carrier assigned to the shipment. Each event records the status, the city and the time.
In which order are events added?: In which order are events added?
Created → Picked up → In transit (one or: Created → Picked up → In transit (one or more, each in a different city) → Delivered. The system rejects events out of order.
Can I see a carrier before choosing them: Can I see a carrier before choosing them?
Yes. The Carriers page lists every carri: Yes. The Carriers page lists every carrier with their profile, their shipments, and the likes and views they have received.
Every tracking event gets a SHA-256 hash: Every tracking event gets a SHA-256 hash of its data plus the hash of the previous event (`prevHash` → `eventHash`). Changing any past event changes its hash and breaks every link after it.
Each event hash is also written to the C: Each event hash is also written to the ChainDepo contract on Ethereum Sepolia ({contract}). The record then exists outside our database, so we cannot quietly rewrite it either.
How do I verify a shipment myself?: How do I verify a shipment myself?
Open the shipment page and use \"Verify: Open the shipment page and use "Verify again". It recomputes every hash and checks each one against the contract. Each anchored event also links to its transaction on Sepolia Etherscan.
Anchoring takes a short time after the e: Anchoring takes a short time after the event is saved. The hash chain is valid right away, and the Sepolia link appears once the transaction is confirmed.
No. Sepolia is an Ethereum test network. Anchoring there costs no real ETH.
What is the difference between a shipper: What is the difference between a shipper and a carrier account?
A shipper creates shipments and shares t: A shipper creates shipments and shares tracking codes. A carrier claims shipments and adds tracking events. You choose the type when you sign up.
How do I change my profile photo or deta: How do I change my profile photo or details?
Open My Page → My Profile. A new photo i: Open My Page → My Profile. A new photo is saved as soon as you upload it, and the other fields are saved with "Update profile".
Password reset is not available yet. Ask: Password reset is not available yet. Ask an admin through the community General board.
Shipment tracking you can check yourself: Shipment tracking you can check yourself
ChainDepo tracks freight between Korean: ChainDepo tracks freight between Korean cities. Instead of asking you to trust our database, every tracking event is linked into a hash chain and anchored on Ethereum, so shippers, carriers and receivers all see the same record.
The shipper creates a shipment and share: The shipper creates a shipment and shares one tracking code. Anyone with the code can follow it, no account needed.
Each pickup, transit and delivery event: Each pickup, transit and delivery event is SHA-256 hashed together with the hash of the event before it, so past events cannot be changed without breaking the chain.
Every event hash is written to a contrac: Every event hash is written to a contract on Ethereum Sepolia. Anyone can compare the record on the page with the record on-chain.
